robot_description2: The almighty doomsday weapon, Sunstar is by far the most powerful robot recorded in human history, fueled by the burning heat of a celestial star fusion reactor! His energy is so immensely powerful that as he flares, time itself begins to warp, and within the next second, an entire planet is lost within the blinding light of a supernova. Worshipped as a Sungod by the Stardroids, it was in his profane name that the Stardroids waged their universal war across the galaxies. The whole universe would've been wiped in his flames had he not been sealed many eons ago by a group of brave star warriors. In the end, he was imprisoned, the Stardroids quietly forgotten, and the stars could finally know peace... until Dr. Wily figured it'd be a good idea to repair him!! Upon arising for the first time in many years, he immediately karmically rewarded Dr. Wily by blasting him - of course, Mega Man had to save him. What followed was the most grueling battle of the Blue Bomber's career, ending in an infinitesimally close victory for Rock, and a breath of relief for the rest of the world. Now, shockingly, in one last moment of reflection before his demise, Sunstar acknowledged Mega Man's strength, and his drive. Though peace was unimaginable in Sunstar's time, Mega Man's determination may be the key to peace in his. So, after years of destruction, Sunstar's last act was that of mercy, and in one last blinding flash of light, the Wily Star, the Stardroids, and Sunstar himself, were all lost to the infinite cosmos.
robot_skill_description: Boosts the robot's stats on Time-type fields
robot_skill_description2: The robot's stats are boosted by one stage at the end of each turn when the Time-type field multiplier is high.
robot_quotes_start: The apocalypse emerges... I am the doomsday robot, Sunstar!
robot_quotes_taunt: Robots were created to fight... but I was created to destroy!
robot_quotes_victory: All inferior life forms will be annihilated... You have the honor of being first!
robot_quotes_defeat: Perhaps I was wrong... but I will never know... Farewell, {target_robot}!
